description: Shared search-bot brain. Site bots inherit this. Life changes belong in data/master; rebuild runtime before bots run.

polite.note: Hourly SQLite queue: one phrase per scheduled fire. fromage=1. Persistent Chrome. Cloudflare: human only.

pay_rules.note: Skip when posted max annualized USD pay is under 140k unless the posting explicitly offers part-time/flexible work. Search phrases do not establish working hours; contract alone is not part-time. Ranges reaching 140k stay for Sean's review. Unknown pay, unknown units and non-USD pay stay for review. Hourly annualization uses 2080 hours for comparison only.

verdicts.note: Apply: score>=80 and not SKIP. Wait: 60-79. Reject: under 60 or SKIP. Only Apply and Wait are written to ready/handoff.

output.handoff_note: Local overlay config/search_bots.local.json sets handoff_root to V:\\Bots_Jobs (OneDrive). Public packets only.
